items.title: Basra wastewater plant starts operating at 70,000m³/day capacity
items.desc: Shafaq News- Basra A wastewater treatment plant has begun operations in Al-Qurna district, Basra province, with a designed capacity of 70,000 cubic meters per day, provincial Projects Director Iyad Hadi told Shafaq News on Saturday. Hadi said the plant consists of two treatment sections, each designed to process 35,000 cubic meters of wastewater daily and equipped with three main treatment basins.
